name: opencode-quota-switch
description: OpenCode TUI plugin — sidebar quota panel that follows the active provider (GLM / MiniMax / Kimi / DeepSeek)
comment:dependencies: CRITICAL: keep `dependencies` EMPTY. @opentui/core + solid-js + @opentui/solid must stay host-provided (devDependencies only). Shipping our own copy creates a second render library instance; Solid signal subscriptions cannot bridge to the host render loop and the panel freezes on the first frame (this is why upstream opencode-quota-usage had to drop to imperative rendering — it pinned @opentui/core in dependencies).
